system.description:
You have your "Accel Fang" and "Lone Charge" SR increased by +1 (it may exceed the maximum SR). A sword crafted by a certain swordsmith as a farewell gift for a hero who had been exiled from his country. Though it has no signature and a simple design, its sharpness is exceptional, and it grants the user a speed and agility akin to a gust of wind.

Tamahagane Ingot [Core Material] (440G) + Shinuchi Katana (870G) + Scroll of Acceleration (Intermediate) (280G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 16] (250G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (500G)
